ops.title: Preserve catalog frontier ordering when a retained directory edge resumes
ops.description:
Source-only counterexample: a retained global pending_edge for later B can commit a child directory C after earlier A refresh/sort. install_directory pushes C after A; frontier_after inspects only pending.last, so a candidate in C may be accepted while A is still queued. Actual execution/host occurrence is unproven. The independent NAME panic repair is unchanged and separate.

Owner until acknowledged reassignment: /root/ccx_related_topk_ship/body_streaming. Next executable step: add one deterministic real catalog fixture that parks a directory edge on admission refusal, refreshes earlier A, advances child C under one-NAME budget, and proves the selected winner/frontier. Coordinate Core owner/Root before CI or overlapping source edits; body floor492 remains priority.
